Players Committee card image of [[Dutch (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if Gold 1). While piloting a Y-Wing, for each Y-wing you have in a battle, attrition against opponent is +1 and attrition against you is -1. Y-wing pilots are forfeit +1 here.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/dutch.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/dutch.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
